knownExternalBoundaries: The portal remains disabled until the owner configures an exact domain and password in the native app.
The Windows installer is not Authenticode-signed and may trigger SmartScreen.
Provider account limits, prices and service-side request limits still apply in audit-only mode.
A Content-Length-less runtime response may exceed the byte limit by one final delivered chunk before fail-closed termination.
Browser cleanup does not yet use a Windows Job Object to reclaim an abnormal descendant process tree.
Cloudflare dashboard policy and DNS remain external state and must retain the documented fail-closed configuration.
